leitura.texto:
Weekend weather and road report
Friday will be hot and sunny in the whole state, with temperatures around 33 degrees. On Saturday morning, it will still be sunny, but there will be strong winds in the afternoon. Experts think that heavy storms will arrive on Saturday night, especially on the coast. Sunday will probably be cloudy and cool, around 22 degrees, but it won't rain much. Drivers: the highway to the beach will be very busy on Friday evening, so leave early or travel on Saturday morning. The police say there will be extra officers on the roads. If you are going to the mountains, take a jacket: it will be cold at night.

perguntas.enunciado: How will the weather be on Friday?
What will happen on Saturday afternoon?
Where will the storms be especially strong?
When will the highway be very busy?
What does the report recommend for drivers?
opcoes: Leave early or travel on Saturday morning

perguntas.enunciado: Why take a jacket to the mountains?
opcoes: It will be cold at night.

falas.en: Look at these numbers. We're going to miss the deadline for the Japanese client.
falas.pt: Olha esses números. Vamos perder o prazo do cliente japonês.

falas.en: Really? How many parts do we still need?
Three thousand. And the client is visiting us on Thursday.
falas.pt: Três mil. E o cliente vem nos visitar na quinta.

falas.en: OK. I'll talk to the manager about overtime.
falas.pt: OK. Vou falar com o gerente sobre hora extra.

falas.en: Good. Do you think the team will accept?
falas.pt: Ótimo. Você acha que a equipe vai aceitar?

falas.en: I think so. Most of them want extra money before Christmas.
falas.pt: Acho que sim. A maioria quer um dinheiro extra antes do Natal.

falas.en: Shall I prepare the new schedule?
falas.pt: Quer que eu prepare a nova escala?

falas.en: Yes, please. I promise I'll give you an answer by five.
falas.pt: Sim, por favor. Prometo que te dou uma resposta até as cinco.

opcoes: They're going to miss a deadline.

perguntas.enunciado: How many parts do they still need?
What will Caio talk to the manager about?
Does Caio think the team will accept?

perguntas.audio: I'll talk to the manager about overtime.
aceitas: I will talk to the manager about overtime.

perguntas.audio: Shall I prepare the new schedule?

escrita.instrucao_pt: Escreva a previsão do tempo para a sua cidade no próximo fim de semana (use will, won't e there will be).
Escreva 3 a 5 previsões sobre o seu trabalho ou a sua vida no próximo ano (use I think, probably, I don't think).

fala.pergunta_en: What do you think the world will be like in 2050?
fala.instrucao_pt: Faça em voz alta 3 previsões sobre o futuro, com I think/I don't think.

fala.pergunta_en: Your colleague says: 'I'm so busy and this box is very heavy!' What do you say?
fala.instrucao_pt: Ofereça ajuda em voz alta usando I'll ou Shall I…?

foco_avaliacao: Nível A2. Will/won't para previsões, opiniões (I think / I don't think…will, probably, definitely), decisões na hora, ofertas e promessas (I'll…, Shall I…?), diferença entre will e going to (plano, evidência), vocabulário de clima e previsões no trabalho.
